acceptance_evidence.AC-002-01: New inbound cases persist independent support/commerce/transactions/knowledge bindings. CaseStore rejects binding mutation; keyed registry routes by persisted tenant/kind/account and loopback rejects command/request binding mismatch. Focused integration adds immutable-binding and conversation-bound receipt replay coverage.
acceptance_evidence.AC-002-02: CaseStore migration v4 scopes case identity by tenant/account/source/external id; reopen, failed-migration rollback, stale CAS, and scoped duplicate event tests pass.
acceptance_evidence.AC-002-03: Two SQLite clients concurrently attempt partial refunds; exactly one succeeds. Positive safe-integer money, over-refund, persisted replay, conflicting reuse, and dropped HTTP response replay are tested.
acceptance_evidence.AC-002-04: A real suspended Mastra workflow rejects direct pre-approval tool execution; tampering the persisted command makes approved resume fail without a refund. Local provider now requires the matching persisted approved command.
acceptance_evidence.AC-002-05: Local seed/reset isolation, deterministic scoped knowledge, ambiguous lookup, provider-backed knowledge indexing, and file-only npm local:seed/local:reset commands are covered. Remote URLs are explicitly refused.
acceptance_evidence.AC-002-06: Inbound dedup/reopen and pre-start versus active recovery branches are covered; the real Mastra regression persists a pre-start dispatch, uses getWorkflowRunById, starts it with stable run id, and observes the suspended approval state without automatic approval.
acceptance_evidence.AC-002-07: Outbox 429 is retryable, permanent 400 fails visibly, lease reclaim after an effect-before-receipt crash reuses a payload-bound durable receipt.
acceptance_evidence.AC-002-08: All four ports are exercised through in-process and actual 127.0.0.1 HTTP loopback adapters, including timeout, 429, validation, refund dropped response, and receipt replay.
acceptance_evidence.AC-002-09: Source-mode Mastra Studio startup with a temporary file database reached ready state. App migrations await Mastra composite storage initialization before local recovery starts, and file-only runtime fixture protection prevents remote seeding.
